verdict.rationale: Docs show balance-per-account retrieval and payout scheduling APIs, which are building blocks for reconciliation, but there is no evidence of a dedicated reconciliation/reporting API, scheduled file exports, or rolled-up settlement reports designed for finance-stack consumption. Missing for 10: dedicated reporting/reconciliation API (e.g. Sigma or Reporting API), scheduled file delivery mechanism, explicit rolled-up multi-seller settlement report format, and any first-party or community evidence of automated reconciliation workflows.
